title: A bound criterion can pass on a check that ran at an older source revision than the run's newest sighting
outcome: A pass on a criterion bound to a typed check rests only on checks of the source revision the evaluation judged. evaluate refuses a pass that cites a check of another revision, and done treats an evaluation holding one as stale (verification_source), whether the binding's obligation was satisfied or waived. A stale passed check can no longer seal the item behind only an untested-change disclosure.
acceptance: The design is agreed consult-first by Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable and Engram::Coder. One shared citation validator runs at fresh evaluate admission (R5) and again when done consumes the evaluation, whether the binding's obligation was satisfied or waived. Exact replay stays before admission. A new stale cause, verification_source, is added, and F4 stays. The cited check's source revision is compared with the revision the evaluation judged: its declared source basis, workspace included when one is declared, or else the run's newest revision-bearing sighting at the cut.

The validator is implemented with tests. Case D: a passed check at R_d, then a source edit to R_e without a check. An evaluation after the edit that passes citing the R_d check is refused at evaluate, naming the citation and both revisions, and nothing is appended. An evaluation holding such a citation, as an older build admitted it, is stale with verification_source at done, on the satisfied and on the waived obligation path. A check rerun at R_e then passes and seals. The tests also cover a declared basis that disagrees with the newest sighting in both directions, a quiet source move, a stale citation beside a fresh uncited check, F4 on and off, and an exact replay of an admitted record that recovers it before the refusal.

docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md (R5, F3, freshness and stale reasons), docs/shipped.md and docs/features/local-work-system.md state the rule, and the live TermAl proof (step 4, case D of the migration) is re-run on the new build and recorded.
